2609.12851.title: MedRoundsQA: A Persona and Difficulty Aware Evaluation for Multi-Turn Medical Consultations
2609.12851.paper_summary: Medical benchmarks are dominated by single-turn, multiple-choice clinical cases that poorly reflect real consultations. Practically, clinicians elicit evidence interactively and patient communication varies widely. We introduce MedRoundsQA, a multi-turn diagnostic benchmark derived from 1,387 board-exam cases across 17 specialties. Each case is converted into a structured 24-slot clinical record, and then instantiated as controlled doctor-patient dual-agent dialogues under varying patient personas, with the underlying clinical content held fixed. We further classify cases by difficulty using model-based uncertainty to enable easy-to-hard analysis. Evaluations of fifteen LLM doctor agents show that (i) moving from a single-turn diagnosis on the standardized records to multi-turn consultations causes large degradations of roughly 13-39 points; (ii) more turns reliably improves question relevance, but diagnostic accuracy exhibits diminishing returns and typically plateaus after 6-12 turns; and (iii) patient persona differences can shift diagnosis accuracy by about 7-8 points (lowest to highest education), highlighting equity risks that single-turn benchmarks miss.
2609.12851.paper_summary_zh: 醫療基準主要由單輪、多選擇的臨床案例主導，這些案例無法真實反映實際的諮詢情況。實際上，臨床醫生通過互動方式獲取證據，且患者的溝通方式差異很大。我們介紹了 MedRoundsQA，這是一個多輪診斷基準，源自 1,387 個來自 17 個專科的考試案例。每個案例被轉換為一個結構化的 24 槽臨床記錄，然後在不同的患者角色下實現為受控的醫生-患者雙代理對話，並保持基礎的臨床內容不變。我們進一步通過模型基於不確定性來對案例進行難度分類，以便進行簡單到困難的分析。對十五個 LLM 醫生代理的評估顯示：（i）從標準化記錄的單輪診斷轉向多輪諮詢會導致大約 13-39 分的顯著下降；（ii）更多的輪次可靠地提高了問題的相關性，但診斷準確性表現出遞減回報，通常在 6-12 輪後達到平穩；（iii）患者角色的差異可以使診斷準確性變化約 7-8 分（從最低到最高教育水平），突顯了單輪基準忽視的公平風險。
